jsQR 1.4.0 — QR code reader in plain JavaScript, by Cosmo Wolfe and contributors.
Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE). Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR (commit 8e6a036), file dist/jsQR.js, unchanged.
Used by AccessCare to read a doctor's QR code from the camera when the browser has no built-in QR reader (BarcodeDetector).
